articleTitle: Bin Picking Pneumatic-Mechanical Gripper for Industrial Manipulators
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The human body is an advanced and complex machine. A simple task like grasping an object, which is done intuitively, has puzzled researchers for decades. For each object, humans have a suitable grip to grab it optimally and safely. Even for objects which we have never seen before, we can choose the best possible grip and can adapt as the environment changes to get a better grip based on cognition and experience. One of the main capabilities of humans is their ability to learn about unfamiliar things and processes. This capability helps us adapt to different situations and still be able to solve a problem. This works focuses on developing a self-learning robotic system which can replicate the human learning capabilities in a handing-over task. The proposed system consists of two submodules: 1) Vision analysis and environment monitoring, which provides accurate global and local information about the area in which the robot has to hand over the specific object; 2) Safe and flexible bin-picking gripper, which handles various objects with complex geometries. The work is a consortium of 3 partners: IWU Chemnitz (Germany), Novosibirsk State Technical University (Russia) and Technical University of Sofia (Bulgaria) under European program ERA.Net RUS PLUS 2017

articleTitle: The Never-Ending Story of Digital Transformation - How to Embed it in an Organization
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Digital Transformation is a topic that is on the radar of every senior executive. We have long now crossed the borders of IT and moved into the pure Business domain. Many initiatives start and finish on business level, so that in the end the organization changes as a whole. Still there are some misconceptions about that term. Is all of the transformation digital or there is something more to it. The goal of this article is to describe what the different levels of Digital Transformation are and how to embed it on a long term in an organization. The approach is simple, but efficient - address the key focus areas: people, processes, and technology.

articleTitle: Magnetic Gear Design Optimization by Genetic Algorithm with ANN Controlled Crossover and Mutation
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents a design optimization by Genetic Algorithm (GA) with controlled crossover and mutation by Artificial Neural Network (ANN). Co-axial Magnetic Gear (MG) design has been put under consideration for that research. Optimization process aims the improvement of MGs torques interaction by design sizes variation. Six different optimization parameters are defined which represents the MG design radiuses. ANN is trained for the optimization problem parameters preselection as a part of the GA optimization algorithm. Solution genomes crossover and mutation are controlled during new generation creation. The results obtained for MG design optimization shows the effectiveness of the proposed method, which, we believe, is suitable for wide variety of design optimization problems.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis and Assessment when Investing in Energy from Natural Gas and Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The global energy industry is undergoing a shift in energy production methods that incorporate traditional fossil fuel-based technologies to renewable energy systems, thanks to lower capital costs, mainly for photovoltaic and natural gas energy. To achieve the climate goals and the development of renewable energy, it is necessary to increase the share of energy from photovoltaics and natural gas. It is necessary to perform an analysis and assessment of the risk of investment because this will allow to determine the effects of these risks on the main financial parameters at an early stage of approval of a project. The aim of the study is to analyze the uncertainty and risks of the investment environment in two investment models for investment in energy production from photovoltaics and natural gas, probabilities, trends, and specific risks.

articleTitle: Modeling and Design of a Buck DC-DC Converter with Feed Forward Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper aims to present an approach which modeling and design a buck DC-DC converter through feedforward neural networks (NN - model). To solve this problem, in addition to the line NN called NN - model is created and the reverse - called NN - designer. The inverse network is used to determine the values of the converter elements. Thus, the paper presents an alternative way of designing power electronic devices, which is based on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) techniques, without applying computational procedures, according to a certain design methodology. In this aspect, this method of modeling and design is faster and more flexible than the standard approach, based on the analysis of the processes in the power scheme in an established mode of operation, after the completion of the transients. The proposed AI approach is confirmed by the parametric design of a synchronous Buck DC-DC converter, oriented to achieve maximum efficiency. The converter is applied in the autonomous power supply system by converting the input voltage from 20 V to 10 V. One of the main advantages of the model used is that it is invariant with respect to the different versions of the MATLAB.

articleTitle: Developing a Functional Scheme of an IoT Based Module to an Acoustic Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Recent technologies of low-cost computing and low-power devices have opened researchers to a wide and more accessible research field, developing monitoring devices for deploying Wireless Sensor Networks. The acoustic sensor networks are very useful for the science and for the people- building smart home systems, detecting damages, studying the noise pollution in the cities or just making indoor acoustic measurements and acoustic calibrations. One of the most important parts in the acoustic sensor networks are the acoustic sensors. They provide “the material” that the processing unit analyzes after the measurements. It is very important these acoustic sensor networks to be improved and automated. This is the main goal of this article and it brings a solution developing a functional scheme of an IoT based module. The proposed acoustic sensor will be applied in the future research works to develop algorithms for processing, analyzing and transferring the captured acoustic information in an acoustic sensor network, using deep learning neural networks and artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Neural Network Long-Term Predictions
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Long-term predictions of time series is a task with multiple applications. Exploiting neural networks for such problem has not been studied enough for financial purposes. An empirical study of specific cases with real financial multivariate time series and data augmentation was performed. The results are compared for different neural network models and two datasets using standard and customized spectral evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Using Natural Language Processing for Quality Assurance Purposes in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Nowadays, quality is the most important attribute that creates value. It is considered as the competitive advantage of private and public organizations by which they differentiate their products or services. Quality assurance in higher education is concerned more than ever before. This paper presents a system intended to facilitate some aspects of the quality assurance process in the universities by helping both the quality assurance officers as well as lecturers. The system accepts as an input the learning outcomes of syllabuses and program curricula and based on some specific rules performs consistency checks between them, assuring that program delivers to students what it actually promises.

articleTitle: IoT System for Electric Discharge Acoustic Spectrum Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work a IoT monitoring system for electric discharge acoustic spectrum measurements is presented. Electric and acoustic parameters of AC electric arc discharge in normal air pressure are recorder simultaneously. Correlation of acoustic spectrum to electric voltage, current and power has been estimated. Analysis of harmonic spectrums of electric and acoustic discharge dynamic parameters has been performed. There is a good agreement between electric power spectrum and acoustic power spectrum of the AC arc discharge. The proposed IoT system could be applied in future for electric switchgear prognostic and predictive monitoring.

articleTitle: Impact of the Wildfires on the Power Supply Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The transmission and distribution of the electric energy occurs through transmission lines, which are most often located in forested areas. Often different environmental conditions and human factors cause forest fires, which can affect cable transmission lines. In this paper, a model of transfer of dangerous heat under the influence of wind from one wildfire to other parts of the forest is considered, which also affects the areas with transmission lines. Safety recommendations are given.

articleTitle: Comparison of Boost Converter Topologies for Charging Single Cell Li-ION
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents a study for comparing boost converters for single cell Li-ION battery boosting circuit used in power-bank devices. A comparison is made with a synchronous internal switch boost converter against an external switch non-synchronous converter. Efficiency, load-and line-regulation characteristics are presented alongside the operating regimes of both converters. The study can be useful for field applications engineers to determine the choice between an internal switch or external switch topology and synchronous against non-synchronous converter. On the other hand, the research is useful from a methodological point of view in studying the basic circuits of power electronic converters with different applications in power electronics courses, as they aid and support the development of analytical thinking and the accumulation of the students' practical experience during the different courses.

articleTitle: Model-Based Optimization of a Serial Resonant DC-DC Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The paper presents a model-based optimization of a serial resonant DC-DC converter. The essence of this method for the optimal design of power electronic devices is on the basis of simple dependences to determine the initial values of the circuit elements, and subsequently by applying optimization procedures to obtain their final values. This avoids the use of more precise but at the same time more complex design procedures and methodologies. The use of this approach is justified from the point of view of the fact that the tolerances of the building blocks of power electronic devices are in a fairly wide range - 20÷30%. In this way, it becomes a natural combination, complement, and development of classical design methods with innovative, based on the application of techniques of modern computational mathematics and modeling.

articleTitle: Constrained Continuous Bending in Trapezoidal Calibers with Three Grooved Rolls
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work was investigated the possibility of realization of severe plastic deformation process using continuous constrained bending with a small relative bending radius R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf>/T≤1 in trapezoidal calibres (CCB Conform 3R2D), realized with the help of two rolls and a bending roller. Two variant solutions of the CCB3TR process with a bending roller above and below the axis of the rolls are analysed with respect to the accumulated strains in the individual stages of the process. The distribution of the values of the workability parameter ß<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">intσ</inf> by SPD is determined in the cross section of the deformed work-piece during successive passage through the two deformation zones.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Potential estimation using Neural ANFIS approache
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The evaluation of the wind potential is an important basis for the installation of a wind farm. In the literature, many projects use the Weibull distribution to characterize the intermittency of the wind speed for wind potential assessment. The neurofuzzy system approach for estimating the wind distribution for wind potential assessment has been shown through these studies to give a better accuracy in the estimation than the Weibull distribution.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Degree of Penetration of Blockchain Technology in the Bulgarian Entrepreneurial Ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Blockchain technology is gaining popularity in developed economies, but there is a tendency to enter developing countries. Bulgaria is among the examples in which the development of technology is discussed at every business event and scientific forum. More and more companies are looking at technology in an attempt to achieve significant competitive advantages, which in turn will help them position themselves in global value chains. The perception of the technology within the company is associated with many challenges, greatly limiting the mass distribution in the Bulgarian entrepreneurial ecosystem. The main reasons leading to the decision to use innovation are the need to digitize business processes, but the final decision to include in Blockchain's information infrastructure is influenced by external and internal stimulating and limiting factors.

articleTitle: Impact of Using Third-Party Logistics Provider on Organizational Performance in the Bulgarian Context
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This study aims to verify empirically the impact of logistics outsourcing to third party logistics providers on organisational performance. The research was carried among small and medium-sized manufacturing organisations in Bulgaria. The research hypotheses about influence of outsourcing of warehousing operations, outsourcing of transport operations, outsourcing of inventory management and supply chain integration on the performance of the organization has been studied. The statistical calculations proved that the main four components of logistics outsourcing had a positive effect on organisational performance. The tests evidence the developed linear regression model is statistically significant and it can be used to evaluate the influence of the four factors on the organisational performance in the Bulgarian context.

articleTitle: Analysis of Methods for Identifying Key Stakeholders of Oil and Gas Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: the success of achieving strategic priorities, in the cases of our research object (building and forming a constructive dialogue with stakeholders with social content and oil and gas companies) is largely determined by the effectiveness of the functioning of its system-forming structures. In these conditions, approaches to the management of oil and gas companies as complex economic structures are of particular importance, aimed at countering negative trends, contributing to the solution of strategic tasks of increasing the competitiveness of the oil and gas sector and the economy as a whole. The purpose of the study is to develop the conceptual foundations of managing complex economic structures of the oil and gas sector of the economy, ensuring their balanced development taking into account new trends in the development of this sector and the economy as a whole and building the right interaction with key stakeholders that affect these companies. Ccurrently, the process of identifying key stakeholders is not regulated and companies have the right to independently choose the method of analysis and interaction with stakeholders, since the existing standards and codes in the field of corporate governance and social responsibility are advisory in nature.

articleTitle: Behaviour Study of Analogue Circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the proposed article analysis of different types of analogue circuits has been made. Investigations about the impact of the feedbacks, included in analog amplifiers, on the characteristics and the stability of the analysed circuits have been carried out. In order to make the study easier computer program has been implemented.

articleTitle: Short-Term Electricity Load Forecasting Using K-Means Clustering - Artificial Neural Networks Hybrid Model: Case Study Of Benin Electricity Community (CEB)
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work, a hybrid model based on K-Means Clustering and Artificial Neural Networks is proposed to predict the Republics of Benin and Togo electricity consumption supplied by the CEB interconnected power grid. This approach consists in first classifying the load data according to different day profiles. Two profiles corresponding to working and non-working days are elaborated for this purpose. In a second step, each class of data is predicted using Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs). The results obtained from this mixed approach are compared with those obtained from a generalized model of Multilayer Perceptron Artificial Neural Network. The results show that the proposed hybrid model gives best performance for CEB electricity load prediction.

articleTitle: Surface Noise Monitoring and Analysis During Chassis Dynamometer Test
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This paper presents an overview of the idea of measuring the road surface by measuring noise. Current developments show that the conventional measurement of road surface conditions in motor vehicles is by considering the outside temperature, which is relatively inaccurate, considering influencing factors such as humidity, season and so on. By measuring the noise from the tire contact of the vehicle with the road surface and analyzing the results, a system can be established to more accurately record the condition of the road surface.

articleTitle: Study of the Parameters of the Resonance Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In the presented article study of resonance amplifiers by means of computer simulation program has been made. Some of basic characteristics., concerning the process of design and proper functioning of this type of amplifiers have been considered.

articleTitle: Proposal, Development and Testing of Self-Controlling System for Greenhouse Automatization
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: the usage of advanced technologies in the agricultural sector needs improvement. Smart farming describes the implementation of information and communication technologies in the conventional field production. Unfortunately, most of these systems are not simple and easy to use enough, which makes is harder for the producers to implement them. The key goal of this paper is to propose an efficient system for Smart Production in Controlled Environment. The goal is to achieve cheap, easy to install, setup and use system on the basis of open-source electronic prototyping platform, called Arduino. To extend the capabilities of the system a Raspberry Pi4 is going to be used for data processing and management

Author Keywords: smart plant production in controlled environments

articleTitle: Industrial Development in the Context of Global Changes in Technology and Automation
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Technological development affects all areas of the industrial world. It is most often considered in the context of global technical solutions (Discoveries and Inventions), which also form the problematic strategic interests of the industry. It is also related to the possibility to increase the level of automation of industrial activities using tangible and intangible means located in different parts of the world regulated by world standards, norms and intelligent information systems. Supranational technological structures are already used, which do not identify with a single national territory but form a global technological strategy. Or it is a process of transition to an integrated global technological system that leads to significant changes in global development. The purpose of this report is to examine the impact of this process on industrial activities. during the various phases of this development. Or to trace the relationship between these phases that essentially define technical revolutions.

articleTitle: Improving the Work Process for Checking Websites and Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The main purpose of this article is, on the basis of theoretical and practical studies, to present an analysis of the current state of the work process, via which the activities for checking websites and mobile applications are performed. The analysis is performed through the basic principles of total quality management. As a result of the conclusions made, a model for process improvement is presented, through which quality, reliable, and accessible information can be provided when checking websites and mobile applications for compliance with standardized requirements.

articleTitle: Double Equal Channel Angular Extrusion using Two Rotating Rolls
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: In this work was investigated the possibility of performing Double Equal Channel Angular Extrusion (DECAE R2D2) with two deformation SPD zones with multidirectional shear deformation, realized using two grooved rolls - feeding and output, connected by a common extrusion channel. Variant solutions of the DECAE R2D2 process at three extrusion angles of 90°, 120° and 135° are analysed with respect to the distribution of strains in the two deformation zones. The distribution of the workability parameter at SPD in the two deformation zones was determined at the two larger extrusion angles at which smaller effective strains are realized.

articleTitle: Computer Modeling of Fire Development in a Premises
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The FDS simulation environment is widely used in the calculation of fires, the spread of harmful substances in confined spaces (rooms, premises and entire buildings), as well as outdoors. Thanks to the LES turbulence model used, the program has a much greater versatility than the FLUENT program.

articleTitle: Increasing the Innovative and Technological Representation of Bulgarian Small and Medium Sized Enterprises Through the Application of Key Characteristics with the Drop-Shipping Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This article analyzes key characteristics of small and medium sized enterprises (SMEs) that have an impact on the adoption of the “drop-shipping” supply chain model. The focus is on the modulating capabilities of e-commerce, which creates a prerequisite for the introduction of technological innovations in the organizational structure of enterprises.

articleTitle: Development and Scope of Information Logistics Under the Influence of External and Internal Factors
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Logistics information systems, built on the basis of information logistic processes, like other management systems, are constantly evolving. When designing a modern information system, each organization must anticipate the huge opportunities for constantly increasing the number of automation objects in business processes and expanding the composition of functions and the number of tasks performed by them. Defining the different stages of creating an information system, i.e. the selection of priority tasks has a significant impact on the future development not only of the logistics information system as a whole, but also on its efficient and effective functioning. The purpose of this report is to investigate the development and scope of information logistics under the influence of new technical requirements. On this basis, proposals for the scope of decisions should be made.

articleTitle: Innovation Process and Degree of Innovation and Innovation Activity
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: Annotation: The effectiveness of the innovation process largely depends on the level of its innovation and innovation activity. Moreover, it includes the entire cycle of innovation - idea, design, production, implementation and service. In your development, this process depends on many influences that directly or indirectly affect it. It can be assumed that this is a purposeful human activity of creating innovations in the development of new products and processes, market realization and service. The whole report is to propose an approach for determining, researching and analyzing the impact of the degree of innovation and innovation activity on it.

articleTitle: Composition, Structure and Properties of Thin Coatings from Carbide Electrodes based on TiCN, TIB2, WC and B4C, Produced on Titanium Alloys by Electrical Spark Deposition with Low Impuls Energy
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The present work presents the results of comparative studies of electrospark coatings obtained on titanium alloy Ti6Al4V from tungsten and multicomponent hard alloys, and those with nano-additives. The coatings were applied on a device with a vibrating electrode with low pulse energy - up to 0.07 J. The influence of the energy regimes and the depositing electrode materials on the thickness, composition, structure, hardness of the obtained coatings has been studied. It has been found that through the coatings the microhardness of the coated titanium surfaces increases 2.5 to 4 times. The phase composition, structure, hardness of the coatings were given as indicators for determining the wear resistance of the surface coatings. The results allow to evaluate and select the appropriate electrode materials and the optimal energy for ESD of coatings with increased durability.

articleTitle: Influence of Surface Pre-Layering on the Electroerosion Effect Caused by Electrical Spark Deposition of Hardalloyed Coatings on Titanium Alloys
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: The article discusses the possibilities for electrical spark deposition of hardalloyed coatings on a pre-layered surface of technical titanium and titanium alloy TiAl6V4. The coatings were investigated in terms of their mechanical properties and the obtained erosion / deposition yield effect in ESD with positive and reverse polarity on pre-applied thin layers. Descaling, galvanic activation and electroless nickel plating were used for substrate pre-layering, and ESD was performed with two types of electrode materials in optimized modes.

articleTitle: Study on Significance of Logistics in the Strategies of SMEs
publicationTitle: 2021 IV International Conference on High Technology for Sustainable Development (HiTech)
abstract: This study aims to empirically verify research hypotheses on logistics notability in the hierarchy of functional strategies for SMEs. The examination was carried among small and medium-sized business units in Bulgaria. The statistical calculations indicated that the waged testing methodology is dependable in terms of selected variables and conceptual model. The main dissection factors were analytically tested and demonstrate validity for further disquisitional work. The analysis indicated that the developed linear regression model is statistically significant and it can be used to assess the matter of the analysis factors on importance of the logistics for Bulgarian SMEs.
